History Explorer can be used to create full function bundles of the entire history. You can also Alt+drag and drop any history step onto the canvas to create a preset shortcut of the step for future use. This update required changes to almost every (40+) process in SASpro!

Stacking Suite now will show free space and estimated usage when you calibrate lights or integrate along with a warning if SASpro thinks you will not have enough harddrive space.

Various bug fixes.
